features.title: We cradle your shoulders gently
features.text: Our mid-height backrest hugs just the right areas, offering relaxed support that helps your body feel light and at ease.

features.title: Designed for relaxed posture
features.text: Angular armrests aren’t just striking—they’re shaped for ergonomic comfort, letting your arms settle into a natural, restful position.

features.title: A seat that softly gives in
features.text: Inside the cushion, pocket springs and soft foam work together to create a gentle sinking sensation—like being welcomed home.

features.title: Raised to make room for life
features.text: We’ve elevated the base on sturdy solid wood legs so cleaning underneath is simple, and your space always stays fresh.

features.title: We keep things cool and cosy
features.text: Wrapped in towel-like fabric with looped threads, our upholstery feels soft, breathable, and soothing to the skin—perfect for all seasons.
